body: Found this from launch week and it made me smile. I still think those Friday chai runs got us through that crunch.
What are you building these days? Would love to hear, no need for a long reply.

photo.caption: Friday chai, launch week 2019
photo.alt: Two glasses of chai on a wooden table

fun_fact.text: Fun fact: "chai" and "tea" come from two Chinese words for the same drink, one that travelled by land and one by sea. Either way, it got us through launch week.
fun_fact.source: World Atlas of Language Structures, chapter 138 "Tea" (Östen Dahl)
